label: Wildlife Control & Nuisance Animal Removal
default_tone: practical and reassuring, emphasizing humane, safe removal over alarm

content_slots.local_relevance: Which nuisance species are the real local problem varies a lot by region: raccoons, squirrels, opossums and skunks dominate complaints across northern and midwestern states (88% of complaints in one Illinois study), while armadillos and snakes become major regional issues in southern states like Georgia and Texas, where armadillos also tear up lawns and undermine foundations digging for grubs.
content_slots.seasonal_calendar: Squirrel maternity season peaks February-March as winter litters near full size and become active; bat exclusion work is legally restricted during June-July bat maternity season and resumes in August, making August the busiest month for bat jobs; rodent and raccoon calls climb through fall and winter as animals seek warm spaces to den.
